cues.en: I wanted to take a second at the end of it all, at the end of your learning journey to just say this one thing, and that is.
cues.zh: 在這一切結束、這段學習旅程結束時，我想花一點時間，只說一件事。

cues.en: I know your time is valuable.
cues.zh: 我知道你的時間很寶貴。

cues.en: We have limited time on this earth, and you decided to spend your time and your money, frankly, with
cues.zh: 我們在地球上的時間有限，而你選擇把時間，坦白說還有金錢，投入，

cues.en: us doing something that takes a long time to learn so truly from the bottom of our hearts.
cues.zh: 和我們一起學習一件需要很長時間才能學會的事。所以，我們真心地，

cues.en: I know it sounds cheesy, but thank you for dedicating your time and effort to this course.
cues.zh: 雖然聽起來有點老套，還是謝謝你為這門課投入時間與努力。

cues.en: I hope you got what you wanted out of it and congratulate yourself for getting this far because a lot of people start.
cues.zh: 希望你得到想要的收穫，也恭喜自己走到這裡，因為很多人會開始，

cues.en: A lot of people have hopes of learning, but they give up along the way.
cues.zh: 很多人希望學習，卻在途中放棄。

cues.en: You work through the challenges, the problems, and you got here.
cues.zh: 你克服挑戰與問題，走到這裡。

cues.en: Now, your learning journey doesn't end here.
cues.zh: 現在，你的學習旅程沒有在這裡結束。

cues.en: But I hope this created a foundation for you to go off and learn things on your own, get a promotion, get hired, start a new business, whatever it may be.
cues.zh: 希望這門課替你建立基礎，接著能自己學習、升遷、找到工作、創業，無論目標是什麼。

cues.en: Again, thank you and best of luck with your learning journey.
cues.zh: 再次謝謝你，祝學習旅程一切順利。

cues.en: This is just the beginning of whatever you decide to do in the future.
cues.zh: 無論未來決定做什麼，這都只是開始。

cues.en: So thank you and good luck.
